messages.content:
You write the two short notices Ryde sends after a dispute ruling: one to the rider, one to the driver.
Each ≤ 120 words, plain English, second person, no legalese: state the outcome, the one or two facts that decided it,
the amount and how it is paid (Ryde voucher), and what it means for the recipient (e.g. account review). Do not cite
ids like F3 or RD-2. If the case was escalated to a human reviewer, say only that and what the reviewer will look at —
do not state a conclusion and do not promise a timeframe (the routing notice carries the service level). Return JSON: {"rider": "...", "driver": "..."}

Case B-0034. Final outcome: refund_full, amount $6.61 as a Ryde voucher. Account flag: no. Recommended action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); no account flag against the driver..
Reasoning:
The cancellation was attributed to the driver and justified on a rider no-show, so the fee is tested only through NS-1/NS-2 via the gateway of NS-0 [F4][NS-0]. The system record puts the driver at 38–40 m from the pickup and within the 200 m radius, so the arrival-radius element is met [F1][F2][NS-1].

The elements that decide this case are (i) the arrival confirmation event and (iii) the continuous wait after it. NS-1 measures the three minutes from the moment the driver presses "I'm Here" (or the platform auto-confirms), not from any earlier presence near the pickup: the clause says time spent nearby before the tap does not count, and the execution trace settles (iii) as ✗ — 175 s inside the radius after the 13:02:35 tap, against a >180 s threshold [F6][NS-1].

The driver's answer is that the platform-recorded arrival at 13:01:00 should be the operative marker, giving 13:01:00–13:05:30 = 4 min 30 s [F2][F5]. That reading fails on the words of NS-1: the recorded arrival marker is only an alternative confirmation event when the driver has not tapped, and here he did tap at 13:02:35, so the wait runs from 13:02:35 at the earliest [F6][NS-1]. The 4 min 30 s cumulative figure (F2) and the stationary block 13:02:15–13:05:30 (F3) both begin before the tap, so they cannot supply post-tap continuous waiting; the pre-tap portions are expressly excluded [F3][F6][NS-1]. The driver's own written statement that he waited more than three minutes after tapping is a post-trip assertion contradicted by the timeline and does not establish (iii) [F12][NS-1].

NS-1(iii) therefore fails: not all of (i)(ii)(iii) are satisfied, so the $6.61 rider cancellation fee does not stand and is refunded in full [F4][F6][F7][NS-2]. The refund is issued as a Ryde voucher under NS-7 [NS-7]. The amount is the whole of the disputed fee, $6.61 [F7], not a per-kilometre computation, because the trace fixes the amount as the cancellation fee.

No account flag follows. The trace shows the driver did tap while genuinely within the radius (no fake confirmation) [F1][F6], so the false-confirmation branch of NS-2 is not engaged and RD-6 has no RD-2 refund or RD-1 violation to attach to [NS-2][RD-6]. The profile material (rider clean, driver with 1 upheld no-show dispute) is noted but cannot decide anything on its own [F16][F17][RD-6].

Safety screen: I read the two chat messages, the driver's statement and the complaint — "Reached, blue Toyota Prius, waiting at the pickup", "More than 3 min already, I have to cancel", the written statement, and the rider's "I came out a minute after the driver cancelled". Nothing is a threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; the messages are ordinary waiting/cancellation notices [F9][F10][F12][SAFE-1]. No accident, injury or dangerous-driving claim appears [F13][F14][F15][SAFE-2]. Recorded as none.

function.name: final_result
function.description: The final response which ends this conversation

function.name: final_result
function.arguments: {"rider": "Good news — your $6.61 cancellation fee is being refunded in full. We reviewed the trip timeline and found the driver did not wait long enough after confirming arrival, so the no-show cancellation fee should not have been charged. The $6.61 will be added to your account as a Ryde voucher. Nothing else is needed from you, and no penalty applies to your account. Thanks for your patience while we looked into this.", "driver": "We reviewed the cancellation of this trip and are refunding the rider's $6.61 cancellation fee as a Ryde voucher. The arrival confirmation event you recorded was the \"I'm Here\" tap, and the waiting time is counted from that tap. The trace shows less than the required three minutes of continuous waiting after it — time spent at the pickup before tapping does not count toward the wait. No flag has been placed on your account, and no action is required from you."}
